rule: A prompt is 'yes' when arm D can answer it with no outbound access other than the LLM endpoint, using the local data lake (/data/chembl, /data/clinvar, /data/alphamissense, /biolab_data), the local models (fpocket, P2Rank, PocketMiner, the normal-mode analysis, the contact network) and the local structure cache (/data/structures, mounted read-only and identically into both arms).  A prompt is 'no' when it needs a live service (the RCSB/PDBe entry search, STINGAllo, the UniProt REST API) or the UniProt-PDB residue mapping, which the tools fetch from the RCSB Data API today.  The classification is a capability judgement made before any run; no result was consulted.
